journey.name: scheduled backup status
journey.description: On an unfunded disposable dev wallet with working staging VSS and Electrum, verify that a queued backup shows Running during its five-second debounce and becomes Latest Backup after acknowledgement. Start at Home in English. No profile, payment, recovery-phrase access or wallet reset is required. Android-only regression: the iOS VSS ownership change did not alter backup scheduling or its running status.

actions.action: Open Settings, select the General tab, and open Local Currency (testTag "CurrenciesSettings")
Choose a different local currency, then immediately open bitkit://screen/backup-settings
Verify that the Settings row shows Running and does not show Retry while its backup is queued
Wait for the Settings row to show Latest Backup after the VSS acknowledgement
Verify that Settings has no Failed Backup message or Retry button
